summary:
**Project Summary – EarthEcho**

EarthEcho is an interactive website that transforms information about Earth's changing systems into sound, making our planet's environmental changes easier and more interesting to understand.

Inspired by NASA's Earth observations, we developed a platform where users can explore different environmental events through geographical images and their corresponding sounds. Users can select an image and click the Listen button to hear a sound associated with that particular event. The website helps users experience environmental changes through both visual and audio elements. It also includes interactive features that encourage users to explore and understand different Earth systems.

Our project addresses NASA's challenge of translating Earth Information Center visualizations into sound. By combining images and audio, EarthEcho makes scientific information more engaging and accessible, especially for students and young learners.

EarthEcho is important because understanding environmental changes helps build awareness about our planet and the challenges it faces. It brings science, technology and creativity together to help people see, hear and understand Earth.
details:
Project Name: EarthEcho

Domain: Environmental Science and Web Development

1. Project Overview

EarthEcho is an interactive website that transforms information about Earth's changing environmental systems into sound. Inspired by NASA's Earth observations, it combines geographical images and audio to make environmental science more interesting and understandable.

2. Proposed Solution

EarthEcho allows users to select environmental images and click the Listen button to hear sounds associated with specific environmental events.

3. Key Features

  • Interactive environmental image gallery.
  • Audio playback for selected images.
  • Image-to-sound experience.
  • User-friendly website interface.
  • Environmental awareness and interactive learning.

4. Technologies Used

  • HTML – Website structure.
  • CSS – Styling and design.
  • JavaScript – Interactive features.
  • Audio API – Sound playback.
  • NASA Earth Data – Environmental information and images.

5. Objectives

  • Make environmental learning engaging.
  • Create awareness about Earth's changes.
  • Combine visual and audio experiences.
  • Help students understand environmental science.

6. Future Scope

  • Real-time NASA data integration.
  • AI-based sound generation.
  • Interactive world map.
  • More environmental categories.
  • Educational quizzes.

7. Conclusion

EarthEcho combines science, technology and creativity to help people understand Earth's environmental changes through images and sounds.

Tagline: See the Earth. Hear the Change. Understand Our Planet.
